summary: TETRA Technologies filed an 8-K to disclose a Master Services Agreement between its wholly owned subsidiary TETRA Bromine Project LLC and Diversified Construction Design for construction services on Phases 2 and 3 of the Evergreen bromine production facility. The agreement covers a substantial majority of the remaining construction scope with approximately $95 million in expected costs. Terms include performance warranties, liquidated damages capped at $2.0 million, and termination provisions. No special situation event is present—this is a routine operational contract filing with no change of control, restructuring, or other corporate event.
